web.dashboard.title: Dashboard
web.errors.notFoundBody: This page doesn't exist in the new admin yet.
web.dashboard.noData: No data in the last 30 days.
web.lists.help.what: A list is a group of subscribers. Use lists as topics people opt in to, and send campaigns to one or more of them.
web.lists.help.private: Private lists are only visible to admins. Public lists appear on the public subscription page and in subscription forms.
web.lists.help.archive: Archive a list to hide it from pickers and public forms without deleting its subscribers.
web.subscribers.help.what: A subscriber is one e-mail address. Their subscriptions to lists carry the opt-in status.
web.subscribers.help.blocklist: Blocklisting stops all e-mail to this address, whatever lists they are on.
web.subscribers.help.attribs: Attributes are free-form JSON you can use in templates and in queries, for example city or plan.
web.templates.subjectRequired: A transactional template needs a subject.
web.templates.help.what: Campaign templates wrap the body of every campaign you send: header, footer, branding. The placeholder marks where the campaign content goes.
web.templates.help.tx: Transactional templates are complete messages with their own subject, sent through the API (and from automations).
web.campaigns.invalidHeaders: Headers must be a JSON array of objects, one header per object.
web.campaigns.help.what: A campaign is one message sent to one or more lists, now or on a schedule. Create it as a draft, write the content, send a test, then start it.
web.campaigns.help.content: Pick a format, a template and write the message. Switching format converts the content, which can lose formatting, so you are asked first. F9 previews it.
web.campaigns.help.lock: Once a campaign is running, finished or cancelled its content is locked. Pausing it makes it editable again.
web.analytics.pick: Choose one or more campaigns and a date range to see their views, clicks, bounces and links.
